result.markdown:
# Extended Outage Following Fiber Maintenance in Sahel

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Maintenance window overlapped start, but outage persisted 189 min past completion. External events not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 09:15 to 2026-09-28 15:05
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 09:21
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011, LNK-SAH-01-B

## Summary

Fiber transport link degradation or extended post-maintenance fault on LNK-SAH-01-B kept sites offline long after maintenance completion.

Traffic and availability dropped on three sites in Sahel for six hours due to link outage.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 09:15: Traffic and availability drop started on three SAH sites. [ALR-0035]
- 2026-09-28 09:21: Planned fiber splice work started on LNK-SAH-01-B. [MW-0013]
- 2026-09-28 09:29: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011, and S-SAH-005. [ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- 2026-09-28 11:56: Planned fiber maintenance window completed. [MW-0013]
- 2026-09-28 15:05: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on all three sites. [ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- 2026-09-28 15:15: Alert ALR-0035 ended as metrics recovered. [ALR-0035]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users and availability dropped on S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, and S-SAH-011 for 6 hours. [ALR-0035]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms triggered on all three affected sites at 2026-09-28 09:29. [ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- No configuration changes occurred on the affected sites or their parents between 08:00 and 16:00. [T3]
- Planned maintenance MW-0013 started at 09:21, but the outage lasted until 15:05, 189 minutes after the window closed. [MW-0013, ALM-000487]
- All three affected sites depend on the shared transport fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [T5, T6, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. An extended transport issue or splice complication on LNK-SAH-01-B kept sites down well past the maintenance window closure. [MW-0013, ALM-000487]
2. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: rejected. The outage persisted for 189 minutes after maintenance completion, meaning it cannot be classified purely as planned maintenance. [MW-0013, ALM-000487]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or their parents during the relevant time window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: Changes were checked and no changes were found on the sites or their parents during the window.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate why LNK-SAH-01-B remained down or unstable for over three hours after MW-0013 completion.
- Verify splicing quality and connector loss on LNK-SAH-01-B.

## Sources

- `ALR-0035`: ended alert from 2026-09-28 09:15: 3 site(s) (S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011); region-level SAH; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb
- `MW-0013`: completed window 2026-09-28 09:21 -> 2026-09-28 11:56 on LNK-SAH-01-B: Planned fibre splice work on LNK-SAH-01-B; expected impact: Downstream sites offline during spli...
- `ALM-000487`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-006, raised 2026-09-28 09:29, cleared 2026-09-28 15:05
- `ALM-000488`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-011, raised 2026-09-28 09:29, cleared 2026-09-28 15:05
- `ALM-000489`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-005, raised 2026-09-28 09:29, cleared 2026-09-28 15:05
- `T3`: get_changes(start=2026-09-28 08:00, end=2026-09-28 16:00, node_ids=['S-SAH-005', 'S-SAH-006', 'S-SAH-011'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011 and its parents between 2026-09-28 08:00 and 2026-09-28 16:00.
- `T5`: get_topology(node_id=S-SAH-005, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SAH-005 (site) -> LNK-SAH-01-B (fiber link) -> AGG-SAH-01 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T6`: get_topology(node_id=S-SAH-006, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SAH-006 (site) -> LNK-SAH-01-B (fiber link) -> AGG-SAH-01 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T7`: get_topology(node_id=S-SAH-011, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-SAH-011 (site) -> LNK-SAH-01-B (fiber link) -> AGG-SAH-01 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)

## Verification notes

- [lookalike] MW-0013 on LNK-SAH-01-B ran 2026-09-28 09:21-11:56, but the outage lasted until 15:05 (ALM-000487), 189 min after the window closed. A window explains an outage only if it covers it in time and sits on the affected node or a parent; the part outside it is an unplanned incident on that node.

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SAH-01-B that ended 187 min before service returned; it explains only the first part of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; The sites of LNK-SAH-01-B went down inside the maintenance window on LNK-SAH-01-B and stayed down 187 min after it closed: the part inside the window is planned work, the remainder is an unplanned outage and is labelled an incident. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the start of the outage (LNK-SAH-01-B), but the outage runs hours past its end. Settled by: (1) the outage continues 187 min after the window ends, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN stay active after the window closed instead of clearing with the end of the works.
